method: Desk research. Primary sources preferred; clearly marked reporting used when a recent primary sanction or tender was not located. No parcel certification, closed-deal dataset, rental occupancy series, or local NRI flow series was obtained.

sources.title: MoEFCC CRZ notifications and CZMP approval letters
sources.supports: Registry lists Karnataka CZMP 2019 approval dated 2 September 2022, distinct from the 2011-plan approval dated 7 August 2018. Search-index text was available; direct fetch intermittently failed.

sources.title: Approved CZMP maps 2019
sources.supports: CRZ-IA ecological areas, IB intertidal, II developed areas; IIIA dense rural areas have 50m NDZ, IIIB lower-density rural areas 200m. A locality label does not establish a parcel category.

sources.title: MoEFCC guidelines for updating CZMPs under CRZ 2019
sources.supports: Uses official HTL/LTL, ecological areas, hazard line, village boundaries and census population for plan preparation; web-map distance from the visible shore is not sufficient.

sources.title: Cabinet approves Coastal Regulation Zone notification
sources.supports: Policy distinction between 50m NDZ for dense rural IIIA and 200m for IIIB; temporary tourism facilities have conditional permissions. This is policy background, not a parcel-specific permission.

sources.title: Sea Erosion
sources.supports: NCCR assessment reports 23.7% of Karnataka shoreline eroding, 50.1% stable, 26.2% accreting; this is state-level, not a Malpe plot risk probability.

sources.title: RBI FAQ: Purchase of Immovable Property
sources.supports: NRI/OCI general purchase permissions exclude agricultural land, plantations and farmhouses. Banking-channel payments; repatriation routes depend on acquisition funding, legal acquisition, taxes and other conditions; foreign-exchange-funded residential route restricted to two properties.

sources.title: KMC Manipal clinical material in the hospital
sources.supports: Reports average daily outpatient attendance of 4,318 and average daily bed occupancy of 1,429 for 2025. Hospital activity is a demand proxy, not evidence of private rental occupancy or a rental guarantee.

sources.title: How to reach Udupi
sources.supports: States no airport in Udupi district; identifies Mangaluru as the nearest airport, about 59.4km from Udupi.

sources.title: Lok Sabha discussion: airport request for Udupi
sources.supports: MP asks government to consider a district airport. Parliamentary advocacy is not site clearance, in-principle approval, funding, land possession or construction. Transcript marked uncorrected.

sources.title: Padubidri–Yermal airport proposal gains momentum
sources.supports: Reports conditional central willingness and need for state site identification, feasibility study and a detailed proposal. No operating date established.

sources.title: Board proposes stadium and airport in Udupi
sources.supports: Reports Padubidri/Nandikoor-Belapu site discussion and consultant/master-plan intention. Names are proposals, not confirmed acquisition boundaries.

sources.title: Mangaluru–Udupi–Manipal metro feasibility proposal
sources.supports: Reports a proposed 64km corridor and feasibility assessment steps. No primary sanction, funded construction contract or operational schedule located in this research.

sources.title: NHAI projects under implementation, 1 March 2025
sources.supports: Lists service-road/drainage works, black-spot rectification and strengthening on the Kundapur–Surathkal NH66 corridor. A dated construction list does not establish every segment complete today.

sources.title: Karnataka Maritime Board proposed projects
sources.supports: Lists multipurpose harbour proposal at Malpe and coastal berth at Gangolli, among others. Lists proposals, not operating assets; a berth is not the same project as a new shipyard.

sources.title: Islands of Karnataka
sources.supports: Describes statewide island master-plan intentions and identified islands. Does not demonstrate a completed Malpe tourism PPP concession.

sources.title: KMB identifies ten islands for tourism PPP
sources.supports: Reports Dariya Bhaudurgad, Malpe and Ayaba among Udupi islands identified for PPP consideration. Identification is not award, clearance or opening.

sources.title: Seven islands approved for tourism development
sources.supports: Latest reported Rs307.71cr seven-island approval concerns Uttara Kannada, not Malpe. Do not move this expenditure or sanction into the triad.

sources.title: Blue economy maritime projects announced
sources.supports: Reports cabinet approval of Rs322cr greenfield Gangolli shipyard under PPP DBFOT. No concession award, financial close or operations established by this report.

sources.title: Bhoomi land records service
sources.publisher: Government of Karnataka district service portal
sources.supports: Bhoomi supplies RTC, mutation extract/status and Tippan; recorded ownership changes go through mutation. These records support, but do not replace, title-chain diligence.

sources.title: Udupi district organisation: revenue section
sources.supports: Identifies revenue section responsibilities for conversion, grants, acquisition, PTCL, land reforms and appeals.

durable_drivers.title: Hospital activity supports more than student lets
durable_drivers.text: KMC's 2025 activity points to a year-round healthcare ecosystem. Test separate staff, student and patient-attendant products; do not equate outpatient visits to paid room nights.

durable_drivers.title: Existing access beats proposed connectivity
durable_drivers.text: Underwrite the present road transfer to Mangaluru airport and actual peak-hour access to work or campus. Treat airport and metro upside as optionality outside the base case.

durable_drivers.title: Coastal scarcity is usable-land scarcity
durable_drivers.text: A small coastal parcel with uncertain access, CRZ permissions or erosion exposure can have less useful development potential than an inland plot. Compare total cost per permissible built square foot.

catalysts.name: NH66 access and safety works
catalysts.status: Existing corridor; dated improvement works documented
catalysts.base_case: Count existing access only; inspect actual site ingress, service roads, flooding and peak-hour journey.
catalysts.trigger: Completed local works with observed access improvement

catalysts.name: Mangaluru–Udupi–Manipal metro
catalysts.base_case: Zero premium for unconfirmed stations or opening dates.
catalysts.trigger: Official DPR approval, sanctioned funding, tender award and construction evidence

catalysts.name: Kaup / Padubidri / Nandikoor airport
catalysts.status: Proposal and political advocacy; location not established
catalysts.confidence: Primary request plus reported conditional letter
catalysts.base_case: No new-airport assumption; existing Mangaluru airport remains access anchor.
catalysts.trigger: Site clearance, in-principle approval, funded delivery and construction; verify land and restrictions independently

catalysts.name: Malpe-area island tourism PPP
catalysts.status: Identification / planning reported; local award unverified
catalysts.confidence: Official statewide planning plus local reporting
catalysts.base_case: No guaranteed hotel demand or tourism opening date.
catalysts.trigger: Named local concession award, environmental permissions, finance and actual operating access

catalysts.name: Gangolli shipyard spillover
catalysts.status: Cabinet approval reported; construction / operation unverified
catalysts.base_case: Regional watch item outside the triad; no automatic Udupi–Manipal–Malpe rent uplift.
catalysts.trigger: Concession award, financial close, construction and demonstrated employment/travel catchment

playbooks.title: Buy the letting catchment
steps: Walk the route to the actual campus, hospital or employment entrance during peak hours; locality names are too broad.
Request current rent agreements, occupancy history, association charges, water arrangements, sinking fund and planned repairs.
Reconcile carpet area, built-up area, undivided land share and parking; compare prices on the same area basis.
Verify title chain, sanctioned plan, completion/occupancy evidence as applicable, and the project's Karnataka RERA record where registration is required.
Stress one vacant month, furnishing replacement, collection loss and maintenance before discussing appreciation.
playbooks.stop_condition: The yield only works on full advertised rent with no vacancy, or approvals and saleable area do not reconcile.

playbooks.title: Buy a tenant proposition
steps: Count weekday and weekend frontage footfall separately; inspect parking, loading, signage and road access.
Confirm sanctioned commercial use, fire/life-safety requirements and utility capacity for the intended tenant.
Read lease tenure, lock-in, escalation, deposit, fit-out responsibility, rent-free period and termination clauses.
Stress extended vacancy and tenant replacement costs; a quoted cap rate on fully occupied rent is not net yield.
For mixed use, model residential and commercial leases separately; shared access and services can reduce both uses' value.
playbooks.stop_condition: The intended use needs permissions that are assumed rather than documented.

playbooks.title: Build from a permissible envelope
steps: Match survey number and physical boundaries against RTC, mutation, survey sketch and title-chain documents.
Commission a licensed survey and check legally documented road access, drainage, easements and encroachments.
Confirm land-use designation, conversion status, layout release and planning/building permissions with the relevant authorities.
Price soil/foundation works, slope retaining, rainwater drainage, water, power, approvals and contingencies before comparing plots.
Near coast or tidal water, obtain parcel-level CZMP/HTL mapping and a written permissions assessment before a non-refundable deposit.
playbooks.stop_condition: Road access, title, conversion or development envelope is unresolved.

playbooks.title: Make the exit route work at entry
steps: Establish FEMA residency and NRI/OCI eligibility; overseas residence alone is not the whole eligibility test.
For ordinary purchase, exclude agricultural land, plantations and farmhouses unless a lawful specific route is confirmed.
Use documented banking channels and preserve inward-remittance records, account statements and purchase papers.
Have an authorised-dealer bank and adviser confirm applicable repatriation, tax withholding and filing route before purchase.
If using a power of attorney, verify execution/authentication and precise powers; use independent counsel and a local property manager.
playbooks.stop_condition: A broker proposes purchase of agricultural land now with conversion promised later to cure NRI eligibility.

playbooks.title: Treat a sea view as a legal question
steps: Locate the parcel on the approved CZMP and commission authorised HTL/LTL and CRZ category mapping.
Check tidal creeks/backwaters, ecological features and hazard/erosion exposure as well as the open-sea frontage.
Get a written activity-specific permissions view: residential use, homestay, hotel and temporary tourism facilities have different pathways.
Check existing structures and permissions independently; a building or electricity connection does not prove lawful development rights.
Visit during heavy rain, ask about past flooding and shoreline movement, and price salt corrosion and ongoing maintenance.
playbooks.stop_condition: The entire justification is 'all coastal plots can build after 50m' or a generic distance measured from Google Maps.

playbooks.title: Price the approval path
steps: First establish ownership eligibility, title, land-use zoning and conversion requirements; do not buy assumed permission.
Keep revenue conversion, planning land-use change, layout sanction, CRZ clearance and building permit as separate milestones.
Obtain written professional scope, authority route, estimated statutory charges and realistic holding/servicing costs.
Model failure: capital tied up, no rental income, potential resale limitations and unbudgeted infrastructure obligations.
Use staged diligence and contractual conditions reviewed by counsel where possible; no generic conversion premium is evidenced here.
playbooks.stop_condition: The margin disappears after holding time, fees, servicing, tax and a lower permissible floor area.

risk_matrix.action: Segment tenants and verify real lease renewals, rent collection and vacation gaps.

risk_matrix.risk: Building and access quality / commercial re-letting
risk_matrix.action: Compare frontage, floor, parking, approvals and net rent for similar units.

risk_matrix.risk: CRZ / tidal water / erosion / seasonal hospitality
risk_matrix.action: Map the parcel and underwrite off-season operation and coastal maintenance.

gaps: No verified local NRI/Gulf capital-flow volume or transaction share. Treat Gulf buyer interest as a hypothesis to test with registrations and buyer interviews, not a quantified price driver.
No defensible triad-wide closed-price versus asking-price discount. A single universal bargaining percentage would be fabricated.
No hospitality occupancy/ADR/RevPAR series for the triad. Medical stays, managed rentals and legal coastal hospitality are research hypotheses, not proven undersupplied categories.
No parcel-level CZMP map was certified. This site must not shade an entire locality as legally buildable or free of CRZ.
Infrastructure can proceed without translating into local property returns. No probabilities or uplift coefficients can be presented as empirical estimates.
